results.title: Huawei 5G Ban: Germany's 2026 Deadline and the EU's Plan
results.snippet: On 31 December 2026, a rule that once looked like Germany’s toughest move against Huawei takes effect. Under public-law contracts with Deutsche Telekom, Vodafone and Telefónica, all critical components from Huawei and ZTE must be gone from the country’s 5G core networks by the end of this year, the German interior ministry announced when the deal was signed in July 2024.
